hooks.command: bash -c 'code_changed=$(git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -E "\.(py|html)$"); changelog_changed=$(git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep CHANGELOG.md); if [ -n "$code_changed" ] && [ -z "$changelog_changed" ]; then echo "REMINDER: Code files were modified but CHANGELOG.md was not updated. Add an entry under [Unreleased] before committing."; fi'
